_comment: Money. Everything here is DOLLARS — the app converts to integer cents on load and never uses floats for money after that. Every size in styles.json needs a row in 'base'; if one is missing the app falls back to perSqFt and warns loudly in the console, because silently shipping a made-up price is worse than an obvious gap. Option prices live in options.json (next to the option), and dealer.json can override any of them.

rto._comment: Rent-to-own is how most of this market actually buys. 'factor' is the monthly payment as a fraction of the cash price.

fees._comment: Charges that are not the building: delivery, permits, site prep. Each is a flat dollar amount, or dollars per square foot of the footprint grown by padFt on every side (with a min). zip3 sets a different amount for a 3-digit ZIP prefix; anything not listed pays amount. charge is "always" (on every quote) or "optional" (a service the customer ticks). appliesTo limits a fee to kinds of building ("Sheds", "Garages"); leave it out for all. inRentToOwn: false means the fee is due at delivery and stays out of the monthly payment. Fees are added after the regional adjustment, because they are already priced for the place.

list.name: Delivery and setup
list.blurb: Delivered on our truck and set level on your prepared site. Free for ZIPs starting 440 and 441.

list.name: Permit handling
list.blurb: We file the zoning permit and schedule the inspection. The city's own fee is billed at cost.

list.name: Gravel pad and site prep
list.blurb: We level the site and lay a 4-inch compacted gravel pad, a foot wider than the building on every side.

list.name: Concrete slab
list.blurb: A 4-inch reinforced slab with a thickened edge, poured and cured before the build.

disclaimer: Estimate only. The final price is confirmed when we visit your site. City permit fees are billed at cost. Prices do not include tax.
